sophia: FYI the API reference for POST /v1/generate is inconsistent with the runtime. docs show "prompt" as the main param (string) but the service expects "messages" (array of role/content). also the example response shows "text" whereas runtime returns an "outputs" array.
tom: can you paste where? i couldn't repro earlier.
sophia: here from docs page: ```json
{
  "prompt": "Summarize the release notes.",
  "max_tokens": 120
}
```
runtime accepts: ```json
{
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the release notes."}],
  "max_tokens": 120
}
```
li: good catch. the mismatch is also breaking the generated curl/snippets smoke test in CI. job 10234 failed with parse error. link: https://ci.internal/docs/10234
anna: i can take the doc PR. estimates: update request schema, update response schema to show outputs[] with content/text fields, update python/node snippets to client.generate(...) and add migration blurb. any preferred wording for migration?
sophia: short migration note: "The Generate endpoint now prefers structured messages. Legacy string 'prompt' is accepted for compatibility but will be converted into a single user message. Please migrate to 'messages' to use multi-turn inputs and avoid future breaking changes." add tiny snippet mapping: ```js
// legacy: { prompt: "Hello" }
// new: { messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }] }
```
tom: also add a minimal streaming example for python since many copy it. e.g.: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
for chunk in client.generate(messages=[{"role":"user","content":"List changes"}], stream=True):
    print(chunk.delta)
```
li: note about response schema: outputs is array of objects { "id", "content": {"type": "text", "text": "..."}, "metadata" } and we have token_costs under meta. include that exactly so openapi->sdk generation picks it up.
anna: will also update openapi/generate.yaml and run the schema linter before opening PR.
docs-bot: lint check will run automatically on PRs. :robot_face:
sophia: thanks. please link the PR here after opening, and re-run job 10234 once merged to confirm smoke tests pass.
anna: opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501 — includes schema, examples, migration note, and curl + sdk snippets. tagging @li for schema check.
li: reviewing now. left one inline about naming: ensure the SDK function is generate not create to match runtime.
tom: after merge i'll add a short redirect in the examples page so old links don't 404.
sophia: perfect. this should stop customers from copying the wrong request shape. :thumbsup:
